mascot.name: Rafi the Explorer
mascot.visual_style: Warm, cheerful, hat & compass explorer motif with vector SVG avatars and expressive speech bubbles

design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Combine botanical illustration softness with modern tactile app interaction
Emotion First: Evoke curiosity and confidence through explorer storytelling, friendly mascot Rafi, and rewarding micro-animations
Clear Hierarchy & High Legibility: Large ratio notation (e.g., 3 : 5), readable sans-serif fonts, strong contrast
Multi-sensory Feedback: Color is never the sole indicator of state—always pair green/red with icons, text labels, and patterns
Tactile Large Tap Targets: Min 48px touch zones on mobile & desktop for 10-11 year old ergonomic ease

features: Welcome Banner with Mascot Rafi introducing the ratio quest
Interactive Quick Action Cards for Learn, Visual Lab, Games, Practice

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Parts to Parts (a : b)
lessons.goal: Understand how to compare one specific quantity of items directly to another quantity of items.
lessons.story: Rafi is sorting red berries and blue blueberries in the Colour Garden. Help compare berries to blueberries!

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Parts to Whole (a : Total)
lessons.goal: Learn how one group of items compares to the entire total collection.
lessons.story: At the Fruit Market stall, Rafi packs fruit baskets. Compare the number of green apples to all fruits in the basket.

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Whole to Part (Total : b)
lessons.goal: Master comparing the total collection size back to a single specific part.
lessons.story: Inside the Treasure Cave, Rafi counts total glowing gems compared to gold coins.

lesson_components: Interactive Visual Diagram with shape toggles
Guided Interactive Activity with live checks

visual_lab.counter_board: 4 color/shape counter pools (Red Circles R, Blue Squares B, Yellow Triangles Y, Green Diamonds G) with big +/- stepper controls
visual_lab.comparison_selector: Dropdown / Tabs to compare: Part to Part (R:B), Part to Whole (R:Total), Whole to Part (Total:B), etc.
visual_lab.live_ratio: Dynamic crisp display formatted as `a : b` alongside simplified ratio
visual_lab.dynamic_sentence: Sentence generator: 'For every {X} Red Circles, there are {Y} Blue Squares.'
visual_lab.build_the_ratio: Two-slot interactive drag-or-click input slot to complete target ratios

features: Filter tabs & difficulty tags (Easy, Medium, Explorer)
Step-by-step hint panel powered by Mascot Rafi

minigames: Ratio Detective (Find & fix the wrong comparison)
Build the Basket (Add items to reach exact target ratio)
Choose the Comparison (Identify part:part vs part:whole vs whole:part)
Fix the Mistake (Correct Rafi's draft ratio calculations)

features: Explorer Rank & Badge Collection (12 unlockable badges)
Misconception guide matrix with teaching strategies
Printable Practice Sheet generator with preview modal & printable layout (include answer key toggle)

component_guidelines.buttons: Always use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl, min height 48px, active:scale-95 transition-all, primary buttons in teal (#0D9488) with white text
component_guidelines.cards: bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border-2 border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
component_guidelines.modals_and_drawers: Use Shadcn Dialog / Sheet with backdrop-blur-sm bg-slate-900/50
component_guidelines.ratio_badges: font-mono font-bold bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 dark:bg-teal-950 dark:text-teal-300 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-teal-200 dark:border-teal-800

accessibility_and_testing.motion: Support prefers-reduced-motion in tailwind and framer-motion transitions
accessibility_and_testing.color_independence: All correct/incorrect or shape indicators must have dual representations (icon + text label + color)
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: All interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, counters, and answer slots MUST include data-testid (e.g. data-testid="counter-red-plus-button", data-testid="nav-learn-link", data-testid="practice-answer-submit-button")

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all user interactions support LocalStorage persistence seamlessly.
Use British English throughout the UI ('Colour', 'Maths', 'Market', 'Organise', 'Favour').
Include clear data-testid attributes on every interactive element.
Make the ratio visualizer dynamic and responsive with instant feedback.
Implement the printable sheet generator cleanly for classroom export.
